beats.vo: Every lending position comes down to four numbers. First, L.T.V., or loan-to-value. It's simply your debt divided by the value of your collateral. Second, max L.T.V. That's the most the protocol lets you borrow against an asset. Third, the liquidation threshold. That's the loan-to-value at which your position can be liquidated, and it's always set higher than max L.T.V. Fourth, the health factor.
